blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine Chamber of Commerce and Industry (PCCI) and the Philippine Exporters Confederation Inc. (PhilExport) have welcomed the Bureau of Internal Revenue’s (BIR) plan to expand its one-time tax abatement program to small taxpayers, saying the move would help more businesses resolve outstanding tax liabilities and pending cases. The planned expansion would extend the program’s coverage from micro taxpayers to small businesses with annual gross sales of P3 million to below P20 million. Both business groups commended BIR Commissioner Charlito Martin R. Mendoza for the initiative, citing the relief it could provide to enterprises facing financial pressures and […]...
